# GIF maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/gif-maker/

Create an animated GIF from uploaded image frames with adjustable timing. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Upload three images, choose frame duration and output size and export a looping GIF.

## Limits and checks

GIF uses a limited color palette and can lose detail. Output dimensions and frame counts are capped to keep browser memory use practical.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Modern GIF — local encoding library](https://github.com/qq15725/modern-gif)
